author: Retro Game Corps
description:
The OneXPlayer 3 and X2 Mini Pro are launching later this month, and both have powerful CPUs (from Intel and AMD, respectively) and an 8.8" AMOLED screen (same display as the Lenovo Legion Go 2). Here is a first look at both models, and what they mean for high-end handheld gaming in the future.

More info:
ONEXPLAYER 3: https://www.indiegogo.com/en/projects/one-netbook/onexplayer-3-next-gen-3-in-1-ai-gaming-and-productivity-handheld
X2 MINI PRO: https://www.indiegogo.com/en/projects/one-netbook/onexplayer-x2-mini-prothe-ultimate-3-in-1-oled-gaming-handheld

Note: ONEXPLAYER flew me to Shenzhen to preview these handhelds, but this video is not paid or sponsored. All opinions are my own, and they did not see this video ahead of time.
